Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 6 as introduced will not directly affect state or local funding, but requires all federal funds made available to the state through the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 to be expended only within the coastal political subdivisions of the State (Mobile and Baldwin Counties).
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 6 as passed the Senate will not directly affect state or local funding, but requires all federal funds made available to the state through the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act (GOMESA) of 2006 to be expended only within the coastal political subdivisions of the State (Mobile and Baldwin Counties). In Fiscal Year 2021, approximately $35 million in GOMESA funds were disbursed to Alabama and were allocated as follows:
State of Alabama: $28.04 million
Baldwin County: $3.2 million
Mobile County: $3.8 million
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
